name.en: Atlas Rising: The Return of Jack Atlas

notes: These cards can be obtained by Dueling Jack Atlas.
The following rewards were awarded during this event, based on event points accumulated over its course:

rows.text: Game Mat: The Return of Jack Atlas
Access to Jack Atlas as a playable character
Simple Card Sleeves: The Return of Jack Atlas
Simple Game Mat: The Return of Jack Atlas

notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion (May 5, 2019 during the second run, and February 11, 2019 during the first). The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, and Gold. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
On April 17, 2019, the following missions were added:
